stem: 在金融机构(FI)实施客户筛查系统以检测可能存在的制裁规避行为时,应考虑以下哪些要求以确保有效的名单管理？(选择两项.)

options.A: 只有特定人员才应被允许修改这些名单。
options.B: 仅应使用监管名单，包括外国资产控制办公室（OFAC）和欧盟的名单。
options.C: 名单可以在内部创建，也可以从供应商处购买。
options.D: 所有名单都应在所有司法管辖区用于筛查。

stem_en: To detect possible sanctions evasion at a financial institution (FI), which of the following requirements should be considered to ensure effective list management? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Only specific individuals should be allowed to modify the lists.
options_en.B: Only regulatory lists should be used, including those of the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) and the EU.
options_en.C: Lists can be created internally or purchased from a vendor.
options_en.D: All lists should be used for screening in all jurisdictions.
